CustomField.description: Holds the page section shown in slot 14 of this page. One of 15 numbered slots (Section 1 to Section 15), so a page holds at most 15 sections; the slots also feed the Has Assigned Sections checkbox. Assign and reorder sections in the page section configurator rather than editing these lookups. If the section is deleted, the slot is cleared.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The section shown in slot 14 of this page. The page section configurator sets and reorders these slots; a page holds up to 15.
CustomField.label: Form Component Section (14)
